name: Hope (EMM)
description: The UAE's Hope orbiter — Emirates Mars Mission, known in Arabic as Al-Amal. Reached Mars in 2021 and provided the first holistic global view of the Martian atmosphere through a complete Martian year. Built in partnership with the University of Colorado LASP.
best_known_for: First Arab interplanetary mission; first holistic global view of the Martian atmosphere through a Mars year
